name: Nirai Impulse EX 1
description: The Nirai company once specialized in low cost, mass-market productions. Unfortunately, there was an incident in which an entire batch of Laser FX series exploded simultaneously in various locations around the galaxy, due to a date error in the on-board computer software. After the hasty closure of all the Nirai factories in Festus and Dima, no new weapons were manufactured. The lasers of the EX series are a living relic.

name: Nirai Impulse EX 2
description: The Nirai company once specialized in low cost, mass-market productions. Unfortunately, there was an incident in which an entire batch of Laser FX series exploded simultaneously in various locations around the galaxy, due to a date error in the on-board computer software. After the hasty closure of all the Nirai factories in Festus and Dima, no new weapons were manufactured. The lasers of the EX series are a living relic.

name: Nirai Charged Pulse
description: This rather old laser was manufactured by the now defunct Nirai company. It was created many years ago as its flagship pulse laser weapon. It used to be priceless but has decreased in value over the years and is now pretty affordable.

name: V'skorr
description: The V'skorr is the standard laser weapon of the Vossk Empire. It is manufactured in huge numbers and exported everywhere. A cheap but effective weapon.

name: Sh'koom
description: The overhauled successor to the V'skorr can deliver more damage even though it also has an increased speed and only a minimally decreased rate of fire.

name: Berger Focus I
description: The Berger company is one of the pioneers of stellar weapons technology, including lasers. The company flooded the market every 50 years with a series of new weapons in various designs to suit every budget.

name: Berger Focus II A1
description: The Berger company is one of the pioneers of stellar weapons technology, including lasers. The company flooded the market every 50 years with a series of new weapons in various designs to suit every budget.

name: Berger Retribution
description: This relatively strong laser gun from the Berger company has one of the fastest rates of fire on the market, second only to the Converge series of weapons.

name: Berger Converge IV
description: The Berger company introduced the Converge series of powerful laser pulse weapons to the market a few years ago. Although the technology is currently being replaced by the more powerful Blaster series, the Converge remains popular with all races.

name: M6 A1 "Wolf"
description: The M6 Series of beam lasers release a tremendous amount of energy, which almost immediately dispatch any target. Unfortunately, the M6 Series cannot match the fast reload time of pulse laser weapons.

name: M6 A2 "Cougar"
description: Beam weapons are the sniper rifles of the cannon world. To use a beam weapon effectively, you must aim carefully. Their rate of fire is low, but the damage they inflict is enormous!

name: M6 A3 "Wolverine"
description: Beam weapons are the sniper rifles of the cannon world. A good aim is rewarded with the greatest penetrating power of all automatic primary weapons.

name: N'saan
description: N'saan on Vossk means, "little stab" and is a garden variety blaster weapon.

name: K'booskk
description: The K'booskk is the successor to the N'saan. It is more efficient in every area of performance and definitely preferable to its little brother.

name: Sh'gaal
description: Sh'gaal means "scar" and refers to something every true Vossk is born with. The weapon's name is thanks to the famous warrior Zrrot Grykk who was exiled on Narsaxa. He managed to regain the favor of his leader, which he had previously lost after making inappropriate advances.

name: H'nookk
description: The H'nookk is one of the Vossk's deadliest blasters. It consumes so much energy that the old H'Soc fighter had to be rebuilt because all Vossk warriors wanted to equip their ships with this weapon. That was before the Terran Hervarar series hit the market, which offers greater power with less energy consumption.

name: Luna EMP Mk I
description: EMP weapons disrupt the electrical integrity of a vessel, causing the various systems to fail completely. The Luna Blaster is a weak but fast firing weapon, which should be in every armory.

name: Sol EMP Mk II
description: The Sol Blaster is a more expensive version of the Luna Blaster. In issue 693 of Fire and Forget magazine, the Sol Blaster only scored 58 out of 100 in its hardware review. The reviewer suggested buyers would be better saving their money and putting it toward the more expensive Dia EMP Mk III.

name: Dia EMP Mk III
description: This weapon was created out of necessity after violent attacks on traders became increasingly common. The company GalacticArms saw a good business opportunity and developed a powerful EMP weapon, which was then seized by pirates. The upside is that pirate raids on dealers tend to be less dangerous these days as trader ships are usually only paralyzed, rather than damaged.

name: Gram Blaster
description: Terran engineers are responsible for bringing the amazing Hervarar series of weapons to market. The Gram Blaster is deadly, easy to use and looks damn good.

name: Ridil Blaster
description: The Ridil Blaster comes from the famous Hervarar series and is the faster version of the Gram Blaster. It's less powerful but has a slightly faster firing rate.

name: Tyrfing Blaster
description: This weapon is the pinnacle of the Hervarar series - almost as deadly as the Gram Blaster, but much faster. In the wrong hands, this weapon poses an enormous threat.

name: Micro Gun MK I
description: Even 2000 years after their invention, ballistic weapons still haven't disappeared from the scene. The Micro Guns from this category of weapon are very good value.

name: Micro Gun MKII
description: Even 2000 years after their invention, ballistic weapons still haven't disappeared from the scene. The Micro Guns from this category of weapon are very good value.

name: 64MJ Railgun
description: This weapon uses a 64MJ reactor to generate lightening clouds so fast that they still contain most of their energy when they connect with their target.

name: 128MJ Railgun
description: The 128MJ Multirail was the first weapon in nearly 200 years to be withdrawn from the market and have its production ceased by the manufacturer. The recall was instigated due to the high instability of the weapon, which was prone to causing unpredictable, devastating explosions. Clever inventors have succeeded in recreating the weapon from materials that are relatively easy to procure.

name: Scram Cannon
description: The Scram Cannon is one of the fastest firing guns in the market. The technology is so simple that anyone could build one of these weapons from scratch, but it is still preferable to get an original design, handmade by droids.

name: Mass Driver MD 10
description: Alongside Thermo-weapons, the Mass Driver MD 10 has the fastest rate of fire on the market. Unfortunately, its production requires vast quantities of resources, so the weapon is increasingly rare and a popular target for thieves, who steal them from unattended ships.

name: Thermic o5
description: Thermal Fusion weapons are the latest craze. Some describe them as confetti spinners, others swear by them and never leave dock without them. The o5 is the basic model, so anyone interested in Thermal Fusion can find out if they can handle these powerful weapons.

name: ReHeat o10
description: The big brother of the Thermic o5 supposedly has solar particles from the Weymire System installed within it, giving it slightly increased power. Doubters claim these apparently expensive particles are actually produced very cheaply in the lab, which naturally reduces the weapon's value.

name: MaxHeat o20
description: Only the MaxHeat contains the essences of sun particles from 12 different systems. Their special composition is triggered with electrical stimulation to unleash a continuous chain reaction, allowing for an unprecedented rate of fire.

name: G'liissk
description: Missiles are not very common among the Vossk, although some have been developed for sale to other races, including the unguided G'liissk. The price is almost on a par with a Golden Octopus cocktail, so it is worth careful consideration before going out drinking if the money would be better spent on a complement of G'liissk missiles.

name: Jet Rocket
description: Missiles, which have no guidance system, are better used at close range. The jet version is cheap and powerful and always worth having on-board for emergencies.

name: Amour Rocket
description: Behind the charming name lies a deadly missile, which wreaks destructive havoc while simultaneously attacking the electronics of its target. This characteristic makes it an unpredictable but interesting part of any arsenal.

name: EMP Rocket Mk I
description: A rocket that was built to bring down enemy targets. Because of its speed, it causes additional damage to all nearby targets and should be used carefully.

name: EMP Rocket Mk II
description: A rocket that was built to bring down enemy targets. Because of its speed, it causes additional damage to all nearby targets and should be used carefully.

name: Edo
description: Missiles follow their trajectory until they hit a target or run out of fuel. The Edo guided missile is similar to the unguided Jet Rocket, though somewhat slower.

name: Intelli Jet
description: The Intelli Jet rocket is as intelligent as you would expect, given its name. It is incredibly fast, has automatic target tracking and causes major hull and EMP damage. It is also very easy to produce, though fortunately this is not common knowledge, otherwise the galaxy would be a much more dangerous place.

name: S'koonn
description: S'koonn on Vossk means something like 'fist', though that barely applies to the strange Vossk anatomy. The S'koonn is not necessarily fast, but when it hits, you'll be sorry you ever made any jokes about the Vossk.

name: Mamba EMP
description: A guided missile, which only attacks the electronics of its target. Just before impact, the missile creates an inverse thrust that prevents any direct contact or physical damage to the hull of the target ship before detonating its EMP.

name: Dephase EMP
description: The DEPHASE guided missile causes heavy damage and has the additional effect of generating an electromagnetic pulse that disables its target. The DEPHASE rocket is expensive, cramming two decades-worth of technological achievements into a beautiful shell. So beautiful in fact, that it is used by some wealthy weapons manufacturers to decorate their lobbies.

name: EMP GL I
description: When EMP blasters and missiles are too weak, or the enemies too numerous, grab the EMP GL bomb. When detonated, the EMP GL causes electromagnetic damage across a considerable blast radius. This type of weapon comes in three variants, with the DX version being the most advanced.

name: EMP GL II
description: When EMP blasters and missiles are too weak, or the enemies too numerous, grab the EMP GL bomb. When detonated, the EMP GL causes electromagnetic damage across a considerable blast radius. This type of weapon comes in three variants, with the DX version being the most advanced.

name: EMP GL DX
description: When EMP blasters and missiles are too weak, or the enemies too numerous, grab the EMP GL bomb. When detonated, the EMP GL causes electromagnetic damage across a considerable blast radius. This type of weapon comes in three variants, with the DX version being the most advanced.

name: AMR Tormentor
description: After AMR was almost bankrupted by its poorly received range of digital watches, the entrepreneurs decided to turn their attention to weapons of mass destruction. It turned out to be a lucrative move and the AMR Tormentor is a must for beginners in the field.

name: AMR Oppressor
description: The AMR Oppressor bomb is capable of delivering devastating damage. Set this off near a Space Lounge and expect to shatter several cocktail glasses (but don't expect to be allowed in for post battle drinks afterwards).

name: AMR Extinctor
description: An atomic projectile with the power to affect the gravitational pull of an entire planet at the push of a button. The company was keen for the AMR Extinctor to be a big seller, but production was ceased after it was banned for being in direct contravention of laws concerning interstellar rules of engagement. Blueprints for the weapon can still be obtained on the black market, if you can afford the high price tag.

name: Hammerhead D1
description: A rather slow turret, but if you are looking for comprehensive defense on a budget, you should definitely consider buying the smallest of the Hammerhead series.

name: Hammerhead D2A2
description: An expanded version of the Hammerhead D1 with twin guns, a faster rate of fire and an increased rotational speed. Guaranteed to make any gun nut's heart pound with excitement.

name: L'ksaar
description: Originally developed as a defensive tower for space stations and K'Sarr freighters, the Vossk quickly realized that other races were interested in this turret. In many raids on Vossk transporters, L'ksaar towers were dismantled in the middle of the battle and stolen. This eventually prompted the Vossk Empire to sell the weapon to the Terran and Nivelian systems.

name: Targe Shield
description: The Targe Shield was actually designed for personal protection. With some modifications, however, it is capable of protecting an entire ship, though not particularly effectively.

name: Riot Shield
description: The advertising department did a sterling job of selling the Riot Shield. One ad showed a Nivelian school shuttle being ambushed by pirates. Thanks to the Riot Shield they escape unharmed, and are reunited with their anxious parents.

name: H'Belam
description: H'Belam means "father" and describes a powerful Vossk shield that was released for sale to all races. The Vossk themselves tend to prefer stronger armor than the H'Belam, however, which cannot compete with the top models on the market.

name: Beamshield II
description: A high tensile composition and an excellent regeneration rate make this shield a very popular piece of kit. No wonder at that price.

name: Fluxed Matter Shield
description: Anti-matter shields have been under development for some time, but have only recently become commercially available due to a major breakthrough in stabilization technology. The inventors did not get to enjoy their success for long, as the blueprints were stolen a few days after the discovery was made. There are rumors that a network of black market traders are currently trying to get rich by selling the plans.

name: E2 Exoclad
description: Armor plating protects the ship against all types of weapons fire and asteroids. But this technology is rapidly becoming obsolete, and compared to shields the E2 Exoclad offers little protection.

name: E4 Ultra Lamina
description: This armor is for pilots who want the best possible value for money. Offers adequate protection for most combat situations.

name: E6 D-X Plating
description: The use of hardened DX particles from ancient asteroids is responsible for the E6 armor's special resilience. The cost of this type of armor plummeted a few years ago when a technique for creating the DX particles under lab conditions was discovered.

name: D'iol
description: Vossk-armor is considered the best of its kind in the known Universe and no other race has managed to successfully reproduce it. The D'iol armor is being used more and more often by engineers in the Terran fleet.

name: T'yol
description: An ultra-hard armor from the Vossk elite production. This armor is the pride of Vossk industry and provides the strongest protection in the galactic market today. T'yol means "forehead", not to be confused with T'yool, which refers to the Vossk sex organs. This mix up has been the undoing of many an unfortunate trader.

name: AMR Saber
description: This Saber Mine from AMR was once a very popular ordinance, but has since become less appealing in the face of inexpensive automatic turrets. Nonetheless, many travelers always have a batch of Sabers on board, just to be safe.

name: Neétha EMP
description: This practical mine is capable of disabling ships in pursuit. It works by hitting all ships in the direct vicinity with an EMP wave. A pack of pirate ships in tight formation can be rendered immobile with just one precise strike.

name: Ksann'k
description: For all those who want more kick to their ordinance, there is the Ksann'k. These mines cause serious damage and should only be deployed at a distance of several kilometers from a station or friendly traffic.

name: ZMI Optistore
description: The ZMI Optistore packs the cargo using standard ZMI-compression, which is also used for data compression.

name: Autopacker 2
description: This module is for computerized optimization of the available cargo space, so that pilots can arrange their cargo as efficiently as possible. This method is more effective than the ZMI method, as early versions of that product were prone to destroying some goods.

name: Ultracompact
description: This compression product works by dematerializing cargo at the molecular level. The skillful arranging of pairs of molecules produces quite a lot of extra space, but it can also lead to dangerous mutations. To prevent this happening, each Ultra Compact is equipped with a test module, which traps the more dangerous molecular arrangements.

name: Shrinker BT
description: The Shrinker BT reduces the size of non-organic goods and can save significant cargo hold space. Very few malfunctions have ever been reported, though the story of dealer Tulant Kheont is well known after he was unable to re-enlarge his shrunken explosive charges, and subsequently sold the miniatures as New Year's Day celebration fireworks at Himo. Apparently he made far more money selling the miniatures than he would have done selling common explosive charges.

name: Rhoda Blackhole
description: By creating a stable black hole, the cargo can be sent into an unknown dimension and then retrieved when needed. There have been unconfirmed claims by some space travelers that occasionally some goods fail to return, and that strange artifacts from other worlds have come back in their place.

name: AB-1 "Retractor"
description: Designed by mineralogists and perfected by pirates, the tractor beam offers the ability to pick up objects drifting in space. The Retractor is the slowest variant on the market.

name: AB-2 "Glue Gun"
description: The Glue Gun allows pilots to accelerate the collection speed of drifting objects. It can also be used to transfer cargo from crippled ships to your own, though doing so is completely illegal.

name: AB-3 "Kingfisher"
description: The Kingfisher is the only tractor beam on the market with an integrated process for automatically transferring useful objects to the cargo hold without causing disruption.

name: Linear Boost
description: Briefly increase your ship's top speed. The Linear Boost is the cheapest booster on the market, but also the least reliable.

name: Cyclotron Boost
description: Although only slightly better than the Linear Boost, the Cyclotron is a top seller. Its balance between performance, recharge time and affordability has been key to its success.

name: Synchrotron Boost
description: The Synchrotron Boost is in a different league to its predecessor, the Cyclotron Boost. It accelerates the ship to more than double its normal top speed and is ideal for fast, in-orbit maneuvers or escaping tricky situations.

name: Me'al
description: The Me'al booster is extremely rare, and if you see one on offer you should buy it immediately. It is easily the most powerful booster on the market. The Vossk restrict its sale, perhaps to avoid granting their enemies an advantage.

name: Ketar Repair Bot
description: This repair robot automatically makes in-flight repairs to your ship's armor and hull. Very useful for those who often find themselves in a firefight.

name: Static Thrust
description: Installing control nozzles improves your ship's maneuverability. The Static Thrust is a basic model, which is reflected in the price.

name: Pendular Thrust
description: A medium control nozzle that can be installed to any type of ship for increased maneuverability.

name: D'ozzt Thrust
description: D'ozzt jets come from the Vossk production facilities. They are pre-installed as standard in the H'Soc ship, giving it incredible maneuverability despite its considerable weight.

name: Mp'zzzm Thrust
description: Mp'zzzm jets were the brainchild of the famous clan leader, Irrkt Yennot, who was sick of losing in a popular pirate shooting game. Thanks to the powerful Mp'zzzm jets, Irrkt was able to reach the pirate's hideout quicker and never lost against his opponents.

name: Pulsed Plasma Thrust
description: This very powerful control nozzle makes even the heaviest ships a breeze to handle. For safety reasons, the Pulsed Plasma Jet is sold with an additional padded headrest. It's also advisable to secure all cargo and avoid carrying live stock while using this upgrade.

name: Telta Quickscan
description: Scanners allow pilots to safely detect unknown objects, such as asteroids and other ships. The Telta Quickscan is very slow, however, and does not have support for cargo recognition, making it useless for pirates.

name: Telta Ecoscan
description: The EcoScan is one of the most widely used scanners on the market. Its popularity is thanks to its reasonable price and support for cargo recognition.

name: Hiroto Proscan
description: Like its big brother the Ultrascan, the Proscan can lock-on to a target in just under two seconds, saving valuable time.

name: Hiroto Ultrascan
description: The Hiroto company specializes in fast scanners with high price tags. The Ultrascan is the only scanner that displays asteroids with a core directly in the radar, making it easy to identify A-class celestial bodies. An essential piece of aparatus for anyone who wants to mine ore professionally.

name: Khador Drive
description: Named after its inventor, a Grey, the Khador Drive allows interstellar travelers to journey anywhere in the universe. This incredible feat is made possible by the Void crystals ebedded in the device, each of which contains a miniaturized image of the entire universe. The drive replaces the need for jumpgates and makes it possible to travel to the Void realm without the use of a wormhole.

name: IMT Extract 1.3
description: IMT manufactures extremely reliable drilling tools that can be used to mine ore on asteroids. The smallest model is only suitable for a short period of drilling, as it lacks the accuracy needed for deeper excavations.

name: IMT Extract 2.7
description: IMT's successor to the Extract 1.3 was really just a new firmware update, though the company still charged the price of a completely new device. Since there were no real alternatives on the market, the proliferation of version 2.7 was widespread and it quickly developed into an industry standard.

name: K'yuul
description: The Vossk brought a mining laser to market some time ago, which they simply called K'yuul, meaning "drilling" in the Vossk tongue. The drill's laser is amazingly accurate, though the constant need for re-calibration reduces the quantity of ore it can mine in any given session.

name: IMT Extract 4.0X
description: IMT is the dominant player in laser-based mining equipment and has a wide range of products to suit every possible need. The newly launched version of its successful 4.0X Extract series is the best drill that money can buy.

name: Gunant's Drill
description: This drill was designed by the Mido scrap dealer Gunant Breh. It is an incredibly powerful device, and if it ever achieves mass-market adoption, it could potentially end up putting IMT out of business.

name: Small Cabin
description: Passenger cabins allow for the transport of civilian space travelers, and are a prerequisite for taking on any of the lucrative transport missions.

name: Medium Cabin
description: Passenger cabins allow for the transport of civilian space travelers, and are a prerequisite for taking on any of the lucrative transport missions.

name: Large Cabin
description: Passenger cabins allow for the transport of civilian space travelers, and are a prerequisite for taking on any of the lucrative transport missions.

name: Sight Suppressor II
description: Stealth generators can hide a ship from prying eyes almost completely. It lasts for a short time and is useful for sneaking up on enemies or quickly escaping dangerous situations. The Sight Suppressor II is an entry level model.

name: U'tool
description: The Vossk U'tool is a very powerful device. Rumor has it that each of them is connected to a central Vossk computer that can disable the unit remotely. Because of the uncertainty over the U'tool's security, the device is not as popular as the Terran-built Sight Suppressor series.

name: Yin Co. Shadow Ninja
description: A very efficient stealth generator that is believed to be custom built. Should this device make it into mass-production, space will become a very empty place.

name: Drinking Water
description: There are still places in the galaxy where there is no drinking water. As unfortunate as this might be, dealers certainly enjoy the trade benefit caused by the need for fresh water in certain systems.

name: Medical Supplies
description: Although most serious diseases have been eradicated over the centuries, the increase in inter-species mating means there are always new infections cropping up that must be dealt with.

name: Space Waste
description: Some dealers cannot stop buying space debris, convinced they might find something valuable hidden in the waste. The problem is so widespread there's even a special type of clinical therapy available for combatting the addiction.

name: Artefacts
description: Archeology - be it bones, books or cell phones.

name: Rare Animals
description: The universe is full of interesting animals, such as K'mirkk frogs, Mhura bees or Zepar Kumppa stilts. Most animals can be used or prepared in various ways.

name: Rare Plants
description: On some planets the boundary between animals and plants is blurred. Some of these specimens fetch an extremely high price on the open market.

name: Drugs
description: Since almost every station is now equipped with contamination shields, the threat posed by drugs is quite low. Many illegal substances are still regularly used in the Space Lounges, however.

name: Luxury
description: There will always be goods that go beyond the typical needs of buyers and considered unnecessary or wasteful by the majority of customers.

name: Premium Food
description: Neuro-algae Apocce, Zepar honey or eggs of the rare S'iik beetle are foods that only some people can afford. Whether they are actually more palatable than less exotic food is purely a matter of taste.

name: Basic Food
description: For today's nutrition, almost all foods are created in laboratories, packed with flavor, vitamins and are prepared in a visually appealing way. Naturally produced foods are usually only eaten on special occasions.

name: Organs
description: There are also synthetic organs available on the market but real ones are cheaper most of the time.

name: Vossk Organs
description: Whether you want to cook a tasty dish, or study them for research purposes, Vossk organs aren't readily available and you will usually have to search long and hard for them.

name: Buskat
description: Buskat is the remnant of an imploded star and therefore extremely rare and expensive. The wives of various luxury obsessed dictators, known for their extravagance, often use it on special occasions as a spice or narcotic.

name: Collectible Figure
description: A statue with a familiar face. Everyone should have one of these figures.

name: Digital Watch
description: The AMR company produced these watches as part of a retro trend. They ended up being one of the company's biggest commercial flops of the last 500 years. The watches were not set on stellar unit time, but an outdated 24-hour period used by the Terrans, making them practically useless.

name: Towels
description: A towel is one of the most useful objects a space traveller can have. You can wrap yourself in it for warmth; use it as a blanket; use it as a sail, a weapon, a mask, a flag, or even just to dry your body.

name: Implants
description: Jump out of a moving ship without dying, win an arm wrestling match against a Vossk, attract the gaze of a woman at the other end of the bar, or just look good naked. All this is possible with implants.

name: Explosives
description: Good explosives are manufactured by the Nivelian in the Nesla System and are used primarily for mining resources

name: Documents
description: Important-looking documents that are definitely missing.

name: Secure Container
description: A container. It is locked and cannot be opened.

name: Secure Cabin
description: A cabin that was picked up in space. It is closed and has no windows, but you can hear muffled screams.

name: Electronics
description: Electronics today are comprised mainly of quantum and nano components. Even a cocktail glass has nano-electronic sensors built into it, which change the glass's color when its empty so the bartender knows it needs refilling.

name: Chemicals
description: Natural and laboratory-made substances that have all sorts of different applications.

name: Plastics
description: The properties of the polymers within the plastic can be varied at will, giving it a wide range of applications.

name: Nanotech
description: Tiny particles that remain hidden from the naked eye that can be very useful. For example, there are nanobots that can transport medicine to certain hard-to-reach parts of the body and cure contagious diseases.

name: Energy Cells
description: These small cells save a tremendous amount of energy that can be released when needed. Energy cells are highly standardized and can be connected to almost any device.

name: Biowaste
description: Biomass is an edible substance for sentient beings and animals; it is a renewable raw material and an energy source all rolled into one.

name: Radioactive Goods
description: Although no longer classified as extremely hazardous, radioactive goods are still unpopular. Perhaps it is the yellow symbol or the strong lights that make people associate them with danger?

name: Mechanical Supplies
description: Screws, chains, gears, gaskets and everything that is used for power transmission or coupling.

name: Noble Gas
description: Non-flammable, non-water based and virtually colorless and odorless. For inert gases, there are a variety of applications.

name: Microchips
description: Following the discovery of the smallest particles in the universe, microchips have shrunk enormously. If you buy a load of microchips, consider using a hadron microscope to check they are all there before paying.

name: Com. Devices
description: A transceiver for all different ranges, frequency modulations, critical system cabless and more.

name: Optics
description: Optical components for data transmission, wide-range scanners, implants, medical applications and many other uses.

name: Hydraulics
description: The hydraulic was perfected over a thousand years ago and has since been reduced to the nano scale. They're still useful for various applications and relatively inexpensive to produce.

name: Alien Remains
description: Organic and inorganic remains of a Void ship. It looks as strange as it smells.

description: Alcoholic beverages always sell well. Each solar system has its own specialty.

name: Void Essence
description: The bright, vibrant core of an asteroid from the Void world. This will definitely fetch a high price on the open market.

name: Nirai .50AS
description: As a response to the increasing number of pirate attacks, a new type of weapon was developed that is especially well-suited to eliminate smaller groups of opponents while also presenting an inexpensive alternative to bombs. The projectiles have an approach sensor that ignites an explosive charge of plasma when activated.

name: Berger FlaK 9-9
description: Having already demonstrated its competitiveness in the laser industry, the Berger company has now developed a FlaK weapon superior to the Nirai model, thereby harking back to their milleniums-old family tradition. The name of this weapon is a tribute to the excellent craftsmanship of the Berger ancestors.

name: Icarus Heavy AS
description: When this weapon's destructive potential became apparent on the field of battle, a law was created to prohibit its civil and military use. Since then, its deployment has violated all war conventions. Although nearly all stockpiles were destroyed in compliance, a few arms traders managed to steal the blueprint.

name: Liberator
description: This deadly missile can be remotely controlled after being fired. The Liberator is extremely fast and maneuverable and therefore an ideal weapon to destroy groups of opponents from a large distance.

name: Berger AGT 20mm
description: The Berger Group released this automatic turret on the market several decades ago, and it is still produced today. Although much more effective models are available, this weapon's affordable price and efficient design continue to be the decisive factors for its lasting success.

name: Skuld AT XR
description: If you see a ship with a mounted Skuld twin gun, you can assume that the owner does not belong to the official armies of this galaxy. For the rather high price, you receive an excellent performance and can handle intense engagements with ease.

name: HH-AT "Archimedes"
description: The Archimedes is a faithful guardian system which will mercilessly fire on anything classified as hostile by the radar. Due to constant upgrades in the market, the turret is in perpetual development. However, it has been possible to buy leaked blueprints on the black market for some time.

name: Disruptor Laser
description: The high effectiveness of the Disruptor Laser can be attributed to the use of artificially grown crystals that have a high optical density. The expensive lens is designed to achieve a wave length of exactly 438.511nm, which corresponds to the resonance frequency of modern shield systems and therefore destabilizes them.

name: Rhoda Vortex
description: Known for their paradox developments, the Rhoda company has launched another incredible product on the market. During quantum radiation, a secretion extracted from the saliva of the Prosperian protofly generates a dilation field that slows down time for the user.

name: Emergency System
description: This emergency system creates a temporary, impenetrable shield around the ship as soon as it reaches a critical level of damage. After the activation, the module becomes unusable and has to be bought again. The Galactic Tourist Agency is considering the introduction of a law that obligates all cruise ship companies to install these on their vessels.

name: Nirai Overdrive
description: Thanks to improved barrel cooling, this tuning module increases the firing rate of all installed primary weapons. However, the high energy expenditure leads to a reduction in the weapons damage effectiveness.

name: Nirai Overcharge
description: This module ensures that a greater amount of energy is charged between the individual shots from the primary weapons. This results in greater weapons damage at the expense of a lower firing rate.

name: Ketar Repair Bot II
description: A major breakthrough in Artificial Intelligence research now makes it possible for robots to feel love. This repairbot is programmed to "fall in love" with its ship during installation, giving an exceptional boost to its care and efficiency in maintenance and repair tasks.

name: Signature: Terran
description: Signatures are unique identification codes that store biometric data, political slants and the SpaceNet surfing behaviour of the respective pilot. Data privacy experts are critical towards their application and warn against abuse. Spies can take advantage of this security gap to act behind enemy lines without revealing their identity. Fortunately a signature becomes unusable as soon as someone has been uncovered due to misconduct.

description: Signatures are unique identification codes that store biometric data, political slants and the SpaceNet surfing behaviour of the respective pilot. Fortunately a signature becomes unusable as soon as someone has been uncovered due to misconduct.

name: SunFire o50
description: During the development of SunFire o50, the hydrogen reactions observed in the photosphere of stars was used as a model. Through the temporary creation of an extremely strong magnetic field, the resulting electromagnetic radiation can be bundled into enormous kinetic energy. In other words: This weapon is hot!

name: AB-4 "Octopus"
description: In contrast to its predecessor, this tractor beam can collect freight at an angle of 360°. Forgot to close the door to the cargo bay again? No problem.

name: Polytron Boost
description: Many test pilots were sacrificed for the development of this powerful booster. Before a G-force compensator was added as counter-measure, a number of volunteers were pressed flat by the enormous acceleration force. Despite protests, the researchers quite literally sweep the matter under the carpet.

name: Spectral Filter SA-1
description: Originally, plasma filters were used for the observation of the spontaneous methane emissions of metabolic life forms. Soon after, however, they were also used for the detection of rare gas clouds. The filter's false color rendering is based on the fact that intergalactic gas clouds have a higher optical density than the vacuum that surrounds them.

name: Ion Lambda Mk1
description: Ionization missiles are used to bundle gas into plasma orbs, which can be collected and isolated with the aid of plasma extractors.

name: PE Proton
description: The basic model of a plasma collector. Since its proton-alignment mechanisms are no longer up-to-date, the rotation speed of the Proton is comparatively slow. Though it's not one of the best devices on the market, it's still suitable for most purposes.

name: PE Ambipolar-5
description: Due to its wider range and higher rotation speed, the Ambipolar-5 is more powerful that the Proton. The absorption speed of the plasma orbs is a bit slower though.

name: PE Fusion H2
description: This collector makes use of enriched hydrogen-atoms for the stimulation of the plasma orbs. This process results in a particularly wide range.

name: Green Plasma
description: A special kind of gas cloud plasma characterized by its green glimmer. Can be harvested in the midorian border territory.

name: Blue Plasma
description: A special kind of gas cloud plasma characterized by its blue glimmer. Can be found between Aquila and Prospero.

name: Purple Plasma
description: A special kind of gas cloud plasma characterized by its purple glimmer. Can be found near Pescal Inartu.

name: Red Plasma
description: A special kind of gas cloud plasma characterized by its red glimmer. It is very unstable and likely to explode if exposed to concussion. Can only be found deep in Vossk territory.

name: Gamma Shield I
description: A basic means of protection against high gamma radiation. This shield is mostly used in the research of solar activities.

name: Gamma Shield II
description: The Gamma Shield II offers better protection against high levels of gamma radiation than its predecessor. This shield is currently being tested by Deep Science.

name: Nirai SPP-C1
description: A civilian repair-laser, which is particularly popular among traders and merchants. Since its operation range is rather limited, you have to be close to the objects you're about to repair.

name: Nirai SPP-M50
description: The SPP-M50 has been developed by the Terran Navy. The device was only made available for civilian use upon completion of the M200. Hence it is the strongest freely available repair beam on the market.

name: K'mirkk Toad Mutagen
description: This particularly nasty substance is extracted from the poison glands of the giant K'mirkk Frog. It is very rare and hard to obtain for several reasons. On the one hand, its extraction is very difficult due to the K'mirkk Frog's heavy carapace and on the other hand, its transport is extremely dangerous, because the substance is likely to explode if it is subject to repeated concussions.

name: Chromo Plasma
description: Chromo plasma is won by mingling and compacting four different sorts of plasma. This substance is particularly valuable because of its extremely high energy level. Since it is also prone to magnetic deviation, it can only be stored in containers with a special kind of sodil-alloy.

name: Berger SG-100
description: An automatic mobile weapon that can be dropped like mines. The Berger SG-100 is especially prominent among private travellers, who are afraid of pirate attacks. The maximum number of operational units in the orbit is limited to three.

name: Berger SG-400
description:
Die Berger SG-400 had originally been designed for the protection of asteroid farms. This sentry-gun's blasters are strong enough to hold a whole band of attackers at bay.
The maximum number of operational units in the orbit is limited to three.

name: T'Suum
description: The prototype of a sentry-gun developed by the Vossk. It consists of a Sh'gaal blaster protected by a strong D'iol armor plating. The maximum number of operational units in the orbit is limited to three.

name: Shesha
description: Once the missile has been fired, a swarm of small missiles dashes towards its target and detonates with a powerful force. Anybody who has ever survived this "rotary of rockets" will surely agree that these cluster-missles are equally effective and dangerous.

name: Garuda-IV
description: Once the missile has been fired, a swarm of small missiles dashes towards its target and detonates with a powerful force. Anybody who has ever survived this "rotary of rockets" will surely agree that these cluster-missles are equally effective and dangerous.

name: Patala
description: Once the missile has been fired, a swarm of small missiles dashes towards its target and detonates with a powerful force. Anybody who has ever survived this "rotary of rockets" will surely agree that these cluster-missles are equally effective and dangerous.

name: Novanium
description: A just recently discovered strangly shimmering ore which cools down rather slowly.

name: Novanium Core
description: The cemented core of Novanium.

name: Spectral Filter ST-X
description: An improved plasma filter, which indicates potential plasma clouds on the HUD with the aid of thermal waves.

name: Spectral Filter Omega
description: This enhanced version of the ST-X does not only indicate nearby plasma clouds on the HUD but also on the radar. Finding plasma clouds is basically child's play with this device onboard.

name: Ion Lambda Mk2
description: Through the compression of the catalyst-chambers and the usage of a special dry substance as injection fluid, the efficiency of the Ion Lambda has been significantly enhanced. Hence, a lot more plasma is set free upon detonation.

name: Crimson Drain
description: The Crimson Drain is a transfusion beam, which automatically absorbs energy from nearby enemies. After the target has been spotted, the Crimson Drain establishes a radiation-band between the attacker and his victim. Due to different levels of denseness on both ends of the band, a spectral photon-transport is initiated and hence the attacker is able not only to steal energy from his target, but also to use the stolen energy for the re-charge of his own shields.

name: Pandora Leech
description: A Nivelian transfusion beam build on the basis of the Crimson Drain. The Pandora Leech is not only able to absorb energy from up to three targets at once, but it is also much more powerful - yet less wide-ranged - than the basic model. Since this device is not available for purchase on the market, it is rumored to be the prototype of an extremely powerful high-tech weapon.

name: Matador TS
description: After the market launch of the auto-turret, the manufacturers of manual turrets had to increase the firepower of their products drastically in order to stay in business. In this regard, the Matador TS is absolutely state-of-the-art. Any pilot, who perfers to fire his guns by hand, will surely appreciate this powerful weapon.

name: Particle Shield
description: Through the stimulation of the integrated Novanium cores with the aid of a special kind of plasma, the Particle Shield creates a huge antimatter bubble, which may even enclose the whole ship if it is supplied with enough energy.

name: Shock Blast
description: The Shock Blast is also often referred to as "Personal Space Extender" among its users. In case of a direct hit, it throws back its target several kilometres. Since the ship itself works as kind of neutral epicentre throughout this process, it is not troubled by the destructive force of the EMP discharge.

name: Phoenix SIS
description: The Shield Injector automatically charges empty shields with energy. In order to do so, a certain amount of blue plasma is required.

name: M6 A4 "Raccoon"
description: The M6 A4 is the most powerful laser beam in the entire galaxy. If you've mounted several of these lethal devices to your ship, you will be able to pulverize your enemies before they are even close enough to open fire on you. In most cases, a single shot of the M6 A4 is all it takes to turn your target into space dust.

name: Dark Matter Laser
description: Nobody really knows who build this extremely dangerous primary weapon or who introduced it to the market. Even though Deep Science has already assigned a whole research team to this task, the scientists in charge have not yet been able to gather any usable information on the Dark Matter Laser's unique configuration and functionality. Consequently, the origin and operating mode of this mysterious device do still remain a mystery.

name: Mass Driver MD 12
description: The Mass Driver MD 12 is by far the deadliest ballistic weapon that is legally available on the market. The penetration power of the Mass Driver's projectiles is significantly enhanced by an artificial coating which the bullets receive only moments before they're fired off. This procedure results in a damage rate that is absolutely unrivalled for this kind of weapon.

name: Mimung Blaster
description: The latest addition to the Hervarar series of Blasters is equally dangerous, gorgeous and expensive.

name: Fireworks
description: A fireworks missile.
